comment: Whether stock quantity is reduced when an order is placed.
modal: When **Yes**, a product's quantity is decremented as orders are placed. Set to **No** to stop Magento tracking stock levels for sales.

comment: Whether items return to In Stock when an order is cancelled.
modal: When **Yes**, cancelling an order restores the cancelled items to available stock.

comment: Quantity at or below which the storefront shows an 'Only X left' message.
modal: Sets the level under which an 'Only X left' urgency message appears on the product page. Set to 0 to disable the message.

comment: Whether product availability (In/Out of Stock) is shown on the storefront.
modal: When **Yes**, the storefront displays each product's stock availability.

comment: Which message is shown when the requested quantity can't be added to the cart.
modal: Selects the wording shown when a product can't be added in the requested quantity (e.g. a generic out-of-stock notice versus a 'requested qty not available' message).

comment: Default maximum quantity of a single product allowed in one cart.
modal: The store-wide default ceiling on how many of one product a customer can buy in a single order. Can be overridden per product.

comment: The quantity at which a product is considered out of stock (out-of-stock threshold).
modal: When available stock drops to this level, the product is treated as out of stock. Can be negative to allow backorders below zero.

comment: Default minimum quantity of a product that can be purchased.
modal: The store-wide default floor on how many of one product must be bought in a single order. Can be overridden per product.

comment: Stock level at or below which a low-stock notification is flagged.
modal: The threshold used to flag products as low on stock in admin low-stock reports and RSS.

comment: Whether credit-memo items are automatically returned to stock.
modal: When **Yes**, items on a credit memo are added back to available stock automatically when the credit memo is created.

comment: Whether products must be bought in fixed quantity increments.
modal: When **Yes**, products can only be purchased in multiples of the Qty Increments value below.

comment: The increment a product's purchased quantity must be a multiple of.
modal: Cart quantities must be a multiple of this number. Applies only when **Enable Qty Increments** is Yes.
